method:
Walk-forward projection accuracy, 2023-25 regular season (Props Modeler, 2026-11-14).
Each game is predicted only with data from before it:
- Features: data/features/player_games.parquet via common.prep (all rolling features are shift(1)).
- Mean model: stats-only baseline (Poisson GLM, train_backtest.Baseline) per market, refit EVERY WEEK on an expanding
  window (all labeled eligible rows from seasons < S plus weeks < w of season S), then predicts week w.
- Level-drift correction: train_backtest.bias_factor on the out-of-sample prediction stream (strictly earlier weeks,
  17-week window, warmed up with 2022 out-of-sample predictions).
- Distribution: family = the one backtest_results.json picked for that variant (chosen on 2024; noted as a caveat);
  dispersion / empirical ratios for season S fitted only on season S-1 out-of-sample predictions (model trained on < S-1).
- Projection = median of that distribution; range = [p25, p75]; counts use integer quantiles.
- Live variant per market (where it differs): baseline_market / ml_market refit weekly the same way (ML with the
  backtest's fixed iteration count); frozen v2 volume x efficiency (rush_yds, rec_yds) scored as-is on 2024-25 only
  (it was trained on 2018-23, so 2023 is in-sample and excluded; not refit).
Benchmarks: season-to-date average (prior games this season; if < 2 prior games this season, prior-season average;
if no prior-season games either, all prior games), last-8 EWMA (<y>_ewm8, shift(1)). No historical sportsbook lines
exist for 2023-25 in our data, so mae_line = null.
Writes models/projection_accuracy.json. Nothing live is touched.
refit_cadence: weekly expanding window (train = all eligible labeled rows before the target week)
season_avg_rule: season-to-date mean of prior games this season if >= 2 prior games this season; else prior-season mean; else (no prior-season games) season-to-date if >= 1 game, else all prior games
lines_note: No historical sportsbook prop lines for 2023-25 in our data (free sources lack them), so mae_line is null. Only 2026 week 10 live lines exist.
coverage_note: coverage_p25_p75 = share of actuals with p25 <= actual <= p75 (inclusive). Ideal ~50% for continuous stats. For count stats the quantiles are integers, so ties at p25/p75 push inclusive coverage above 50%; compare to coverage_expected_inclusive (the model's own P(p25 <= Y <= p75)) and see coverage_p25_p75_exclusive.

by_market.plain_english: QB interceptions: off by about 0.60 INTs on average, vs 0.68 using his season average and 0.73 using his last-8 weighted average (avg actual 0.61).

live_variant.note: live model is the same variant as the walk-forward baseline above
